title: Switching failure probability for bounded width
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube whose terms each contain at most $w$ literals. For $0\leq\delta\leq 1/3$, choose each coordinate independently to be fixed with probability $1-\delta$ and otherwise left free, and choose the fixed signs uniformly; then the probability that the restricted function has decision-tree depth at least $1$ is at most $3\delta w$.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
Its width is at most the natural number $w$
